name: navatra-news-platform
description: Navatra 4K TV — modern full-stack news platform (Vue 3 frontend + Vue 3 admin + Express/Prisma backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w admin
scripts.test:e2e:telegram: docker compose up -d --build mock-telegram && TELEGRAM_API_BASE=http://mock-telegram:8448 docker compose up -d backend && E2E_TELEGRAM=1 npx playwright test e2e/telegram.spec.ts; docker compose up -d backend
